written: 2026-11-26 (UTC), before part G of scripts/research_v4e.py produced any number
status: Fixed. Exploratory: every candidate here was picked because it came close in round 5. It cannot by itself justify a rule change.
asked_for: The owner asked for the candidates that came closest to the bar to be looked at again.
what_has_been_seen: Round 5: each candidate alone, near highs and on all days, on all periods. Round 5b: v3 plus breadth (E1) on train and test. Not seen: any of the candidates below inside the v3 rule, or combined with breadth.
form: As in round 5b: one more component in the v3 rule, levels at the candidate's 50th, 75th and 95th percentile of 1990-2006, not counted toward floors.

candidates.G3: v3 plus the 126-day rise in the 2-year yield
candidates.G5: v3 plus breadth plus margin-loan growth
candidates.G6: v3 plus breadth, with credit stress read from the Baa spread (round 5 C1)
candidates.G7: v3 plus breadth plus the 200-day trend component of round 5

measures: Train and test O1 AUROC, test near-high AUROC, test O2, state ladder, state changes; 90% interval of the test difference to v3 and to E1 (v3 plus breadth), and the same interval widened for 7 candidates (the 10%/7 percentile).
old_period: 1927-1985 (or from the candidate's first day): drawdown level plus the candidate's level against drawdown level alone; for G4, drawdown plus breadth plus dispersion against drawdown plus breadth.

reading.useful_alone: G1, G2 or G3 clears the round 5 part A bar with the widened interval above zero: record it live alongside breadth.
reading.adds_to_breadth: G4, G5 or G7 beats E1 on the test period with the widened interval of the difference above zero, is not more than 0.02 below E1 on train, and its old-period check is not negative: record it live alongside breadth.
reading.verifiable_and_no_worse: G6 is within 0.01 of E1 on train and test: the Baa spread can replace the high-yield spread in whatever is recorded.
reading.otherwise: Breadth alone stays the one lead.
